front.transcription:
This is a disrupt trial objective.

To set it up, separate the 5 South America City cards from the Player deck, shuffle them, and place 3 of them faceup into the Operations area. These are the 3 trial cities.

Then, shuffle the remaining South America cards back into the Player deck.

Finally, flip this card over and place it on top of the 3 trial City cards.

back.transcription:
APRIL OBJECTIVE 1

DISRUPT THE SECOND TRIAL

Disrupt Trial in:
1, 2, OR 3 KNOWN CITIES IN SOUTH AMERICA AT THE SAME TIME

Completed: Read Debrief 224
Failed: Read Debrief 156

front.transcription:
This objective has an unknown target city.

To set it up, separate the 11 Europe City cards from the Player deck, shuffle them, and place 1 of them facedown into the Operations area.

Then, shuffle the remaining Europe cards back into the Player deck without looking at them.

Finally, flip this card over and place it on top of the unknown City card.

back.transcription:
UPDATE

"Greetings agents. I am Dr. Helen Morris. You may call me Dr. Morris, and I bring tragic news. Former Agent Charles Sabik raided this facility last night to steal data, weaponry, and other key items. During this raid, several individuals were killed, including your CMO, John Cooper."

If the Discretionary Budget card is in the reserve, destroy it.

"I will admit that John Cooper and I rarely saw eye to eye. His disregard for protocol resulted in numerous mistakes over the years, but he remained a deeply loyal and dedicated agent. He will be missed."

front.transcription:
MISSION BRIEFING

"This operation and your continued development falls to me. Be aware that I have high expectations.

You now have three objectives; events are accelerating, and we must adapt. First, MEDUSA research materials are being smuggled out of Johannesburg. Second, Sabik must be brought to heel; he plans to use the materials he stole from Langley in an operation near Istanbul and Peking. Third, the Soviets are building another control center."

OPEN 0004 and read its contents.
